panels.title: Overall Quality Score (24h)
panels.description: Percentage of dq_result checks that passed in the last 24h, across all datasets and dimensions - defaults to 100% if no checks ran (absence of checks isn't treated as failure).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pass') / count(*), 1) END FROM dq_result WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Datasets Checked
panels.description: Distinct datasets with at least one dq_result row in the last 24h.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT dataset) FROM dq_result WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Checks Executed (24h)
panels.description: Total dq_result rows (individual check executions) in the last 24h, across all datasets and dimensions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM dq_result WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Failed Checks (24h)
panels.description: Count of dq_result rows with status='fail' in the last 24h, across all dimensions (schema/freshness/volume/etc).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM dq_result WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND status = 'fail'

panels.title: Freshness Violations (24h)
panels.description: Failed checks specifically in the 'freshness' dimension - data that arrived, but later than its SLA target.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM dq_result WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND dimension = 'freshness' AND status = 'fail'

panels.title: Schema Changes (24h)
panels.description: Distinct schema signature hashes seen in the last 24h minus 1 (the baseline) - a change here means a table's column set/types shifted since the last check.

targets.rawSql: SELECT GREATEST(count(DISTINCT details->>'signature_hash') - 1, 0) FROM dq_result WHERE dimension = 'schema' AND evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Quality by Domain (24h pass rate)
panels.description: 24h dq_result pass rate grouped by the owning pipeline's business domain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.domain, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE dq.status = 'pass') / GREATEST(count(*), 1), 1) AS pass_rate FROM dq_result dq JOIN pipeline p ON p.pipeline_id = dq.pipeline_id WHERE dq.evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY p.domain ORDER BY p.domain

panels.title: Quality by Dataset (24h pass rate)
panels.description: 24h dq_result pass rate grouped by dataset - narrows down which specific table is dragging the overall score.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pass') / GREATEST(count(*), 1), 1) AS pass_rate FROM dq_result WHERE evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY dataset ORDER BY dataset

panels.title: Failed Quality Checks (24h)
panels.description: Individual failing dq_result rows from the last 24h with observed vs threshold values - the detail behind the Failed Checks tile above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT evaluated_at, dataset, check_name, dimension, observed, threshold FROM dq_result WHERE status = 'fail' AND evaluated_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC LIMIT 100
